documents.title: Receipt Of Trading Approval For 15,01,434 Equity Shares Of Face Value Rs. 2/- Each

analysis.summary: Bhagyanagar India Limited reported a turnover of over 700 crores for Q1 FY27, achieving its highest EBITDA margin of recent times at 5.43% and a PAT of 20 crores. Although sales volumes dropped to 5,200 tons due to trade route disruptions in April and May, the company capitalized on shortages to increase margins, with volumes recovering to 2,200 tons in June. The company is planning a corporate restructuring to demerge its copper business into a new entity called Tieramet Limited, while proposing 40 crores of capex over the next two years. Management expects volume growth of 12% to 15% for the full year and remains confident of achieving 5,000 crores in revenue by FY30. Bhagyanagar India Limited released its Q1 FY27 investor presentation highlighting financial performance, a composite scheme of arrangement involving Bhagyanagar Copper Private Limited and Tieramet Ltd, and a preferential issue of Rs.

guidance.claim: The company projected an average copper price of 1,300 rupees per kg at the start of the year.
guidance.quote: 1,300 rupees a kilo is the average which we had projected at the beginning of the year.

guidance.claim: The company hopes to maintain its EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5% going forward in the year.
guidance.quote: Going forward in the year, we hope to maintain the EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5%.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting an export contribution of between 12% and 15% this year.
guidance.quote: One moment. It will be a minimum of 10%, but we are targeting more towards 15%, so we are looking at somewhere between 12% and 15% this year.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of reaching 5,000 crores of revenue by FY30.
guidance.quote: But we are very confident of 5,000 crores by FY30, whatever the copper price.

guidance.claim: Management targets reaching 5,000 crores in revenue by the year 2030.
guidance.quote:
Our top line projection, as in earlier, this thing, has been project... we are aiming for 3,000 crores in the year 2030.
That is, in 3 years, we are planning to reach 5,000 crores in the year 2030.

guidance.claim: The company aims for a 25% CAGR target for the next 3 to 4 years.
guidance.quote: 25% CAGR is our target for the next 3 to 4 years.

guidance.claim: Management expects a minimum volume growth of 15% to 20% every year.
guidance.quote: Between 15% to 20% should be our volume growth minimum every year.

guidance.claim: The company is hopeful of maintaining a 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year.
guidance.quote: We are hopeful of maintaining 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year, and on an increased top line.

guidance.claim: Management is planning to increase the value-added products share up to 66% by the end of next year.
guidance.quote: So, we've already reached around 62% at the end of quarter four, and we are planning to get this up to 66% by the end of next year.

guidance.claim: The demerged company having only the copper business is projected to reach 5,000 crores in 3 years.
guidance.quote: The Demerge Company, which will have only the copper business, will reach 5,000 crores in 3 years.

demand_outlook.claim: The company exported over 100 tons of bus bars to North America in the last quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: In the last quarter itself, we have exported more than 100 tons of bus bars to North America and we are also exporting a lot of transformer products all over the world.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is seeing a lot of demand as of today.
demand_outlook.quote: As of today, we see a lot of demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Existing customers are looking to increase volumes and double their capacity in the next three years.
demand_outlook.quote: All our customers are looking to increase their volumes and everybody is talking about doubling their capacity in the next 3 years.

demand_outlook.claim: Growing sustainability focus and supply constraints are accelerating the transition from primary to recycled copper in India.
demand_outlook.quote: Growing sustainability focus and supply constraints are accelerating the transition from primary to recycled copper in India.

demand_outlook.claim: India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.
demand_outlook.quote: India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.

demand_outlook.claim: Global copper consumption is predicted to double from 26 million tonnes to 50 million tonnes by 2050.
demand_outlook.quote: The world consumed around 26 million tonne of copper, which is predicted to become 50 million tonne by 2050, so this is almost doubling.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth in copper consumption will be mainly driven by EV and automotive, power and electrification, and renewable energy sectors.
demand_outlook.quote:
This growth will mainly be driven by three sectors, EV and automotive.
Because, EV requires a lot more copper than regular cars, power and electrification is also a big growth factor, and renewable energy.

demand_outlook.claim: Management anticipates a big shortage of copper coming after 3 or 4 years.
demand_outlook.quote: The availability, while right now there is no shortage for the next 2 or 3 years for copper. But we foresee a big shortage coming after 3 or 4 years.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has completed adding its capacity of 35,000 metric tons.
capex_expansion.quote: We have also finished adding our capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is online now.

capex_expansion.claim: The management has proposed 40 crores of capex over the next two years.
capex_expansion.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects its 10,000 ton capacity expansion to become operational between April and June of next year.
capex_expansion.quote: So, this has been projected for the next financial year. The exact timelines are still not there, but as of now, our expectation is between April and June of next year; more likely June next year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to increase its CTC wires capacity from 80 metric tons to 150 metric tons a month.
capex_expansion.quote: On CTC wires, our capacity is roughly about 80 metric tons a month and we will be going up to 150 metric tons a month.

capex_expansion.claim: Capacity expansion underway includes a 60-acre integrated manufacturing facility in Hyderabad and INR 40 Cr capex for FY27 & 28.
The company has reached a capacity of 35,000 metric tonnes this year with a new 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.
capex_expansion.quote: Our capacity has now reached 35,000 metric tonne this year, with the new, 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has proposed a capex of 40 crores in the next 2 years.
capex_expansion.quote: So, we have, proposed 40 crores capex in the last, in the next 2 years.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved its highest EBITDA margin of recent times at 5.43% and highest PAT margin of 2.87% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: We achieved a revenue of over 700 crores. We have had our highest EBITDA margin of recent times at 5.43%, our highest PAT margin of 2.87%.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved its highest share of value-added products sold at 63% and highest EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees.
margins_costs.quote: We have also had our highest share of value-added products sold this quarter, which is 63% and our highest EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees.

margins_costs.claim: The company increased its margins in the first two months of the quarter due to trade route disruptions and material shortages.
margins_costs.quote: In the first two months, because of the disruption of all the trade routes and the shortage of material all over the country, while the turnover came down, we could take advantage of the situation by increasing our margins.

margins_costs.claim: The company's purchases and sales are mostly hedged on a daily basis.
margins_costs.quote: So, our purchases and sales are more or less hedged on a daily basis.

margins_costs.claim: Silver-bearing and tin-bearing bus bars for data centers give roughly about 10% EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: So, we are, this product will give us roughly about 10%, EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: The pass-through mechanism for copper prices applies only to price increases and not additional margins.
margins_costs.quote: The pass-on is typically only for the price increase, not the additional margin. You are absolutely right.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's sales volume for the quarter dropped to 5,200 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: However, for the whole quarter, our volume has come down to 5,200 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of the 5,200 tons of volume, 2,200 tons was achieved in the month of June.
orders_capacity.quote: But the good part of this is that 2,200 tons of the 5,200 tons has come only in the month of June.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has finished adding its capacity of 35,000 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: We have also finished adding our capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is online now.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's current CTC wires capacity is roughly 80 metric tons a month.
orders_capacity.quote: On CTC wires, our capacity is roughly about 80 metric tons a month and we will be going up to 150 metric tons a month.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has finalized the first round of fundraising at 52 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we have just finalized the first round of raising, at 52 crores, which is finalized, and the money should be in the bank in the month of August.

capital_allocation.claim: The second tranche of fundraising will likely occur around March after the demerger.
capital_allocation.quote: The second tranche will probably be around March, after the demerger is done, in the standalone copper unit.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's projected debt in 2030 is between 300 and 350 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our projection is showing that between 300 and 350 crores will be our debt in 2030.

capital_allocation.claim: The total fund raise through preferential allotment is Rs. 52.25 Crores.
Total equity increased from 193 crores in FY24 to 207 crores and then to 257 crores through retained earnings without dilution.
capital_allocation.quote: And then from 207 to 257. And this increase in equity was not done through dilution, this was all done through retained earnings.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital increased from 157 crores to 230 crores, which management notes is proportional to revenue.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our working capital has gone up from 157 crores to 230 crores. And this increase in working capital is proportional to our revenue, so there's no, no reason to be concerned.

risks_headwinds.claim: Trade route disruptions and material shortages across the country impacted turnover in the first two months.
risks_headwinds.quote: In the first two months, because of the disruption of all the trade routes and the shortage of material all over the country, while the turnover came down, we could take advantage of the situation by increasing our margins.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced a GST case due to the retrospective cancellation of a supplier's registration.
risks_headwinds.quote: Because of the retrospective cancellation of the registration of the supplier, the case has been put on us.

risks_headwinds.claim: Under GST law, input credit is not available if the supplier does not pay or if their registration is cancelled.
risks_headwinds.quote: But this is because of this particular law in GST, which says that credit is not available if the supplier does not pay and if the supplier's registration has been cancelled, credit is not deemed to have been paid.

risks_headwinds.claim: Rising copper prices will require more funds to cover MCX hedging margins.
risks_headwinds.quote: As the copper prices go up, we will require more and more money to fund the margin for MCX.

risks_headwinds.claim: Short lead time scrap material coming from the Gulf has suddenly dried up, and shipping lines have been diverted.
risks_headwinds.quote:
The scrap coming from Gulf, which is of a short duration, short lead time material, has suddenly dried up.
And, the material which is coming from the rest of the world, the shipping lines have been diverted because a lot of shipping lines have a transit point in Dubai or somewhere in the Gulf before coming to India.

management_commitments.claim: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in FY27 and FY28.
management_commitments.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to execute a complete digital transformation over the next year.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next year, we are going to do a complete digital transformation of our company, where every process, every department and all reporting will be completely digitalized automatically, and no manual entry would be required.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects its 10,000 ton capacity expansion to become operational between April and June of next year.
management_commitments.quote: So, this has been projected for the next financial year. The exact timelines are still not there, but as of now, our expectation is between April and June of next year; more likely June next year.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets reaching 5,000 crores in revenue in the year 2030.
management_commitments.quote: That is, in 3 years, we are planning to reach 5,000 crores in the year 2030.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets a 25% CAGR for the next 3 to 4 years.
management_commitments.quote: 25% CAGR is our target for the next 3 to 4 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management is proposing about 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: We are proposing about 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to scale up plastic recycling over the next year.
management_commitments.quote: So this is, going to... we're going to scale this up in... over the next year.

management_commitments.claim: Management hopes to complete a fundraise of approximately 150 crores in this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We hope to do it in this financial year, definitely.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
